notes.title: Level Editor Beta Update - Community Trails

items.text: The Level Editor beta update is now live on the Steam beta branch - the big one ahead of the full editor release.

You can now browse user generated levels directly in-game — from the main menu and from the trail selection. Download, rate and (if needed) report them right there. This is also the groundwork for cross-platform support.

Levels are now stored on Playfab. They will still be published to the Workshop for visibility, but the published files there are no longer compatible — so all levels need to be republished to be available for others again. Sorry for the extra work, it's a one-time step, and republishing restores everything including comments and ratings.
Also worth knowing: the folder layout changed. On first launch the game moves your local level files into subfolders automatically.
Prop clipboard, configurable Time Trials/Tricks/Freeride challenges, a screenshot tool for publishing, plus a pile of river, path and prop fixes. Full change log below.

To be clear: this is the beta branch only for now. We want to see how it holds up with your levels before it goes out to everyone — which we hope will be very soon. We tested compatibility a lot, but if anything looks off with your existing levels, please reach out right away. Thoughts, bugs and feature requests are highly appreciated!
-your Megagons!
("leveleditor" Beta Branch only)

releases.displayName: FREESTYLERS UPDATE - New Trick & Free Ride Mode & much more!

items.text: The Freestylers Update is finally here, adding two new modes to the game! A completely new Trick Mode and also the beloved Free Ride Mode from Lonely Mountains: Downhill is making its comeback!
In Trick Mode, players compete for style over speed, completing over 100 new challenges in a ground-up reimagining of the Snow Riders experience. The mode unlocks at level 20.

Free Ride Mode was a feature in our last game Lonely Mountains: Downhill, now finally in Snow Riders! The ultimate challenge to all speedrunners, Free Ride removes all checkpoints, allowing players to carve their own ultrafast route down the mountain. You need to reach level 35 to unlock this mode.
Both modes come with full leaderboard support and new achievements, and also allow you to reach the highest player level without competing in multiplayer matches.
The Freestylers Update also comes with a wide range of new accessibility features, including auto-brake, auto-accelerate, toggling buttons instead of holding them, and button mapping.
We would be very grateful to hear your feedback on the new additions, especially the difficulty of the Trick Mode challenges.
You can find the full patch log down below.
We also took the opportunity to update our roadmap for this year. The biggest change is that the PS5 version has moved from Summer to Autumn.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149182/ca7159dd968fcde9a6281df8d06f7c6a1ade2d94.jpg"]
Happy riding and see you on the slopes!
Your Megagons

Free Ride removes all checkpoints and it also uses the Zen version of the trails, allowing for maximum freedom to race down the trails for the best time. It comes with leaderboards and achievements, and full level progression.

items.text: Hello Riders,
We hope you’re all doing well! We just released Version 1.0.4 for Steam and Xbox.
Again, this patch mainly focuses on the multiplayer stability and fixes a whole ton of endless loading screen and disconnection issues as well as drastically reduced initial loading times.

We hope we caught most of them now but as you can imagine it is a nightmare to find and reproduce them all. So please continue sending us your logs in case you have any issues. It helps us a lot and we will keep working through all the issues until we squash the last bug.

Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback on the Quickmatch timer changes introduced in the last patch. Overall the feedback on the mechanic was very positive but most people seem to agree that 60 seconds is a little bit harsh, so we increased the timer to 90 seconds. Please let us know your thoughts if you feel that it now hits a better balance.
Critical: Drastically reduced loading times on first-time start up.
Critical: Fixed a bug where the menu scene wasn’t loaded when returning from a multiplayer tour.
Critical: Fixed a multitude of bugs that caused an endless loading screen or disconnects from multiplayer matches.
Minor: Fixed a bug that allowed players to select locked items.
Major: Polished navigation behaviour for scroll lists.
Minor: Fine-tuned UI controls
Minor: Removed minute prefix for timers on checkpoint lines.
Major: Changed racing end timer from 60 seconds to 90 seconds.
Minor: All timers in solo mode now have two decimal points.

We still have an issue that very rarely a client can’t connect to multiplayer games anymore when being forcefully disconnected from a multiplayer match before. The only way to rejoin multiplayer matches at that point is to restart the game. If this happens to you we would be very grateful if you could send us your log file because we have a very hard time reproducing this one.
We wish you all a great time and weekend on the mountains and see you next week for the next patch.
All the best,
your Megagons

items.text: Hello Riders,
the second big patch is now live on Steam and Xbox. It includes a whole bunch of fixes and improvements but we mostly focused on improving the multiplayer experience!

First, endless loading screens and problems with logging into a lobby should now happen less often but unfortunately we haven’t been able to get rid of them completely. If you are encountering them, it would be much appreciated if you please let us know and send us your log files.

Secondly, we are also introducing a major change to the “end of race”-timer in Quickmatches as we got a lot of feedback that it takes too long to wait for players who are still getting a feel for the game.

From now on in Quickmatch Racing you have 1 minute to finish the trail after the first player crosses the finish line. In Team Mode Quickmatches you have two minutes. Private tours don’t have a timer. If the timer runs out you will be placed on the tour ranking with your current time and rank.

We know that this is a pretty radical change but in our playtests we really enjoyed the new mechanic. It not only reduces the waiting time a lot and improves the pacing of tours, but it also gives an additional thrill and adrenalin boost to finish the trail in time. Nonetheless, we would be really grateful to get your opinion on it! Please give us your feedback in the forum or on our Discord.

We are working full force on improving the game further - tackling issues with the resolution rate which causes a lot of performance issues and the section ghost not working on Xbox among other things.
For now, here is the full log of everything that made it into the patch.
your Megagons

Critical: We fixed multiple different issues that all resulted in an endless loading screen when starting multiplayer tours or trails but sadly it can still happen sometimes. We continue to work on it further.
Critical: Fixed login issues after suspending the game to the background and coming back to it after a day. This was mostly a problem on Xbox but could theoretically also have happened on PC.
Critical: Fixed a bug that players fell through the terrain when changing or reflection quality settings during a run.
Critical: Fixed various memory leaks which could lead to a crash (mainly on Xbox).
Critical: Fixed a softlock when having the “Quit Lobby”-pop-up open while the race-end timer runs out.
Critical: The invite state for lobbies was not updated in all cases. This improves inviting people to your lobby via Discord, Steam Invite and Xbox Invite.

Major: Fixed Leaderboard navigation, display discrepancies and page issues. Please mind that your best leaderboard time might not be your best local time if you were not connected to the leaderboards at that time.
Major: Fixed trail filter not working in the Result Screen leaderboards.
Major: Fixed leaderboards being cut off on certain aspect ratios.
Major: Fixed that the challenge display did not correctly update when hovering with the mouse between blue and black slopes.
Minor: Fixed that sometimes the wrong player was displayed after selecting them on the leaderboards.
Minor: Fixed a UI issue with the team multiplier icon after leaving a resting spot.
Minor: Fixed a small visual glitch on the balaclava.
Major: Added an AFK timer. Players who haven’t crossed the finish line yet and who are inactive during the race for 35s in Quickmatch or 2min in Private Matches will be removed from the tour.
Major: You can now choose between different color schemes (like a high contrast UI mode) in the accessibility settings.
Minor: We added an offline notification in Solo Mode so you know that your times won’t be transferred to the leaderboards while you’re offline.
Major: Improved loading times and performance of imposter generations (imposters are advanced 2D placeholders for objectsthe low level of detail assets that you can see in the far distance).
Minor: Changing a setting option in a drop down and closing it does not reset the navigation anymore.
Minor: Added counting animation when you get new Snowflakes or Exp.
Minor:Updating the experience bar is now in sync with the result screens.
Minor: Polished the emote wheel.
Minor: Fixed overlapping threshold line in the Team Result screen.

Critical: We made a big change to the end-timer mechanic to drastically reduce wait times during tours. In racing quickmatches you now have 1 minute to finish the race after the first person has crossed the finish line, in team mode it’s 2 minutes.
Minor: We exchanged two of the emote icons. 🤚 “Hold” was replaced with 👏 “Clapping” and 🎉 “Celebrate” was replaced with 😂”Laughing”.

topNew: Major: You can now choose between different color schemes (like a high contrast UI mode) in the accessibility settings.
Minor: Changing a setting option in a drop down and closing it does not reset the navigation anymore.

Major: Fixed a rare case where the UI broke when entering spectator camp at the exact moment a run ended.

items.text: Hello Riders,

Reduce the frequent short freezes / lag spikes that appeared especially in the beginning of multiplayer matches
Very rare crash / softlock on the loading screens

Your Megagons: See those little checkpoint and band aid icons in the timeline?
We finally managed to set the new patch live. Thank you all for your patience! We are hopeful that future patches will go more smoothly.
You need to update the demo now to play multiplayer! (Sometimes you have to restart Steam for an update to actually work)

We implemented a new end-timer. So in case a player won’t finish the race or will take too long while everyone else has already crossed the finish line a timer will set in and end the race if the person doesn’t finish in time.
We shortened all waiting times (time until a tour starts, time between trails, time between tours).
Leaderboard Navigation will work with mouse controls again.
We fixed that sometimes network messages (like new host, host disconnected, etc) would stay on the screen until you restarted the game.
We improved the rubberbanding / weird movements that sometimes happen when you respawn at a checkpoint in multiplayer.
We fixed the problem where the timer showing when the next tour starts wasn’t always visible and also redesigned it.
We made the last jump on Trail 2 Hard Slope a little bit easier.
In the future, you will be informed in-game if you need to update your version for multiplayer.
Let us please know if you experience any issues with the new build.

As you might know, Steam now allows you to leave a review for a demo. If you like the game it would really mean the world to us if you leave us a positive review. The Next Fest is super crowded this time and it would help us a lot to get some more visibility for the game!
Your Megagons

First, thank you all for your feedback! We are more than happy to see that you all enjoy the new multiplayer mode! We spent a lot of time on it over the last 4 years, so it’s great that we can finally play together with all of you!

But, who would have guessed, it turns out that making multiplayer games is hard and comes with its own set of problems. One of them is that we just can’t update the game without throwing everyone out of the multiplayer - as a new patch forces you to update the game.
As many people are playing now and we don’t have feedback for a new available update in the game we decided to postpone today’s patch to tomorrow.
So the patch will go live tomorrow around noon (MEST) and it will throw you out of the multiplayer if you’re playing at that moment. You can continue playing after you download the update.

We implemented a new end-timer. So in case a player won’t finish the race or will take too long while everyone else has already crossed the finish line a timer will set in and end the race if the person doesn’t finish in time.
We shortened all waiting times (time until a tour starts, time between trails, time between tours).
Leaderboard Navigation will work with mouse controls again.
We fixed that sometimes network messages (like new host, host disconnected, etc) would stay on the screen until you restarted the game.
We improved the rubberbanding / weird movements that sometimes happen when you respawn at a checkpoint in multiplayer.
We fixed that sometimes the timer that shows you when the next tour is going to start wasn’t visible.
We made the last jump on Trail 2 Hard Slope a little bit easier.

We also want to take this moment and thank everyone who helped us test the demo before the Next Fest. And especially want to celebrate the crazy speedruns that people did with the over-the-top Lynx version. So here are the Top 10 on both slopes for the Pre-Demo. There will also be a little in-game memorial for them but more on that when the game will be released.
We wish you all a lot of fun on the Lonely Mountains! Please keep your feedback coming. It’s highly appreciated.
All the best,
Your Megagons
Hey Riders,
it’s great to see you’re all enjoying the time on the Lonely Mountains! Again, thank you all for your feedback!
We received feedback that it currently takes too long to reach Level 10 in the demo, which is totally understandable considering that you would also like to try out tons of other amazing demos.

So we just put a patch live that rebalances the progression system. You still need to hit the slopes in multiplayer to reach level 10 to earn the special next fest outfit but it should take considerably less time than before. Please download the newest patch to update your level!

Also, if that wasn’t totally clear, you will get the same experience for tours in private lobbies as for the quickmatch tours, so it’s easy to just grab a few friends to level up. We also set up a whole bunch of new channels in our Discord to find friends and private tours.
